description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set fetches all_mailboxes before any mutations and uses this snapshot for role uniqueness checks in both create and update. The snapshot does not reflect mailboxes destroyed earlier in the same request. A request that destroys mailbox A (which holds role 'inbox') and creates mailbox B with role 'inbox' may fail the role uniqueness check because destroyed mailbox A still appears in the pre-mutation snapshot. The post-mutation snapshot is fetched only for the destroy child-check, not reused for the role check. This is a maintainer-visible correctness hazard: it is not obviously wrong from the code, but will generate confusing user reports when a role-swap set fails.
title: Mailbox role uniqueness uses stale snapshot in cross-operation request
